description: This commit adds support for the NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 3 model, enabling the conversion and running of this model. Tech blog: https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/inside-nvidia-nemotron-3-techniques-tools-and-data-that-make-it-efficient-and-accurate/

comments.body: Adjust the indentation here and remove the empty line on 1092

This function also needs 4 spaces indentation.

Also move the `ffn_inp` inside the `else` branch since it is used only there.
I'm kind of surprised we don't have an op to do relu^2. Can it be done with ggml_xielu(ctx0, cur, 0, 1, 0, 0)?

> Can it be done with ggml_xielu(ctx0, cur, 0, 1, 0, 0)?

Interesting, I not familiar with `ggml_xielu` but I'd be happy to look into to this as a follow up on this PR if that is alright.
Yes, we should follow-up. Moreover, Metal does not support xielu yet.

Sure, a follow-on is fine.

I think the code I wrote is wrong, I didn't realize ggml_xielu does the softplus on the constants. I think the right thing might be ggml_xielu(ctx0, cur, -INFINITY, expm1f(1), 0, 0).
